activity.notes: Stepan Topal was elected president of the self-proclaimed, internationally unrecognized Gagauz Republic in December 1991 and remained its president until the separatist institutional structure was superseded by Moldova's autonomous Gagauzia settlement in 1995. ATLAS uses the Gagauz Republic rather than present-day Gagauzia because Topal was not the first Bashkan of the later autonomous territorial unit.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada — Moldova: Chronology of events concerning the Gagauz minority
sources.citation_text: The chronology records the Gagauz separatist institutions and the 1 December 1991 presidential election in which Stepan Topal was elected.

sources.title: European Court of Human Rights — Topal v. the Republic of Moldova
sources.citation_text: The ECHR case background identifies Stepan Topal as President of the Gagauz Republic between 1991 and 1995.
